options.orbit: Threshold, then a central void. You pass between two objects and a screen just inside the door, then circle one hero object standing alone in a large empty void ringed by six small objects. Product stations sit at the four outer corners, outside the loop. The pay desk closes the loop at the back. Size: default 20 x 16 m.
options.field: One open low field. A floor strip leads from the door to a single large hero object; four sculptural stations hold the product in a loose ring around it, and the route wanders between them to the pay at the back right. Nothing but the hero is tall. Size: default 16 x 12 m.
options.chamber: A room inside the room. A walled chamber with two side openings stands in the middle; three low monoliths inside it carry the product; two blocks break through the chamber walls. The route enters the chamber, circles the monoliths and leaves. There is no single hero: the chamber is the event. Size: default 18 x 12 m.
options.ritual: A small ritual room. Shelf walls wrap the left, right and back; one object at the centre is where you pause first; a counter sits at the back. The route circles the centre, then follows the shelves. Size: default 12 x 10 m.

reply.title: The Silent Archive
reply.subtitle: A sanctuary where fragrance replaces the written word.
reply.line: You traverse a serene landscape of strata clay and volcanic stone, where the act of cleansing becomes a meditative prelude to discovering scent.
reply.synopsis: You step into a vaulted space where the scent of aged paper lingers amidst lime-plastered walls. Your journey begins at the center, where a monolithic black stone basin invites you to perform a quiet ritual of purification under soft, diffuse light. As you move, the rhythm of the room pulls you along walls lined with fragrance bottles nestled into porous clay shelves. You conclude your exploration at the wooden desk, where your chosen scent is carefully wrapped and recorded like a rare manuscript.
reply.quote: Fragrance is the invisible literature of the senses, waiting to be read in the silence of the archive.

why.meaning: The clay-clad walls create an immersive, tactile perimeter that mimics the density of a library stack.
Placing the basin at the center forces a pause, anchoring your focus on the sensory experience before you explore the inventory.
The intentional loop movement ensures you engage with the cleansing ritual before transitioning into the discovery of individual scents.
Positioning the desk away from the main path provides a private, respectful space for the final exchange of goods.
